text:
ana: quick sketch for review 1: introduce a narrow annotation lane above the heatmap to display operational markers (deploy, config, incident) and a hover-only sampler preview that shows 3 micro-sparklines with an estimated p95 delta. goal: make sudden p95 jumps explainable without leaving the chart

mike: +1 on observability story. two asks: make the lane collapsible by default (conserve vertical real estate) and add a keyboard shortcut to toggle the timepicker (thinking `t`), power users will love it :keyboard:

sara: a11y first: new lane must meet 3:1 contrast. color labels need textual alternatives for screen readers. propose adding live region announcements when percentile buckets change, e.g., `aria-live="polite"` with "p95 updated to 250ms"

lex: interaction idea for sampler preview: rather than full traces show 3 tiny aligned sparklines for the buckets + badge with est delta. sketch:

```
// on hover fetch up to 3 samples for buckets
const preview = fetchSamplerPreview({range, buckets: 3})
renderSparklines(preview)
showBadge(`est p95 \u0394: +12ms`)
```

kevin: infra note: keep preview client-side and capped to 3 samples. lazy-load on first open and debounce hover at 300ms to avoid extra load. also add telemetry event `annotation_lane_opened` for rollout metrics

jamie: copy nit: change "Compact" toggle label to "Compact (low density)" so non-designers understand effect. also suggestion: default new accounts to compact=false (density on)

ana: tiny correction, should be "ana" above. UX question: align bucket edges to user's local timezone or stick with UTC? local helps correlate deploys to business hours but UTC simplifies aggregation

mike: prefer exposing timezone in timepicker header with default UTC and user preference for local. quick toggle: `Timezone: UTC \u25be`

sara: color ramp note: current purple->red fails some deuteranopia checks. propose blue->amber ramp with numeric ticks `0ms, 100ms, 250ms, 500ms` and an alternate monotone high-contrast theme for a11y

lex: keep annotation lane anchored to absolute time for custom ranges so events don't jump when user zooms in/out

kevin: rollout plan: feature-flag the lane and preview, gather telemetry, then enable by default based on adoption. event names: `annotation_lane_toggled`, `sampler_preview_opened`

dev-bot: deploy-preview: https://staging-console.redwood-inference.com/heatmap-annotations (preview expires in 3 days) :rocket:

ana: thanks all 1. I'll update the figma and add acceptance checklist: 1) keyboard shortcut docs, 2) aria-live for p95 updates, 3) sampler debounce and cap, 4) color ramp a11y test, 5) feature-flag + telemetry. will follow up with mocks and a11y test results later this week :thumbsup:
